guardrails: No universal protocol dominance is assumed.
Topology, member_count, and packet_loss interactions are reported explicitly.
Positive benefit delta always means the left protocol is better for that metric.
Latency comparisons are conditional on both protocols completing and are not interpreted as unconditional performance.
Python packet_loss is not identified with Cooja SUCCESS_RATIO_TX.
No additional simulations were added after observing STEP7B1.

multiple_testing.completion: Holm across all 144 cell-level pairwise completion comparisons.
multiple_testing.continuous_metrics: Holm separately within each metric family across all 144 cell-level pairwise comparisons.

secondary_metric: t100_us conditional on both protocols completing

tests.completion: exact paired McNemar/binomial test on discordant completion outcomes
tests.continuous_metrics: exact two-sided sign test on paired benefit deltas
